# ufbx in Corona

This directory vendors **ufbx 0.23.0** from the official repository.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx>
- Commit: `fcc5d6ba444cfd3eb80677dba5e37e493941abe5`
- License: MIT or Public Domain; see `LICENSE`.
- Local use: statically compiled into `CoronaMeshImport.exe`. It is not linked into `Corona.exe`.

When updating, replace `ufbx.c`, `ufbx.h`, and `LICENSE` together and update the version and commit above.
